saw_head: At akispetretzikis.com, a lot of baskets are paid for by more than one person.
saw_l1: The eshop sells cooking seminars, cookware, cookbooks and Akis' own food range. A big part of that is bought with or for other people: a seminar four friends attend together, a gift set a partner should pay for, a class a parent is treating the family to.
saw_l2: Today the checkout knows one payer and one card. When that person first has to collect money from the others, or wait for someone else's card, the basket stays open, the visitor leaves, and the recipes bring them back tomorrow but the order is gone.
saw_turn: That drop-off is the only thing we charge for. An order recovered through Split or Forward costs 3%. Everything else at your checkout costs nothing.
